description: This file defines a LinkedList class implementing a singly linked list with methods for adding, removing, getting size, and retrieving elements by index.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A private inner class representing a node within the linked list, holding a data string and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private method to unlink a node from the list by adjusting the previous node's next pointer.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Companion object method to find the last node in the list starting from a head node.
